correctness.rationale: The proof is pathwise. Multiplying the polyp equation and its scalar stochastic-logistic comparator by the same positive stochastic integrating factor turns their difference into a linear random ODE with nonnegative forcing, proving the comparator stays below the polyp population. The comparator's explicit solution gives its exact long-time average when the noise-corrected polyp growth is positive. For the weighted total, the source's weight cancels the linear medusa transfer, and an Itô logarithmic estimate yields a finite upper time average because the martingale has quadratic variation growing at most linearly and the logistic comparison prevents exponential collapse. All source-parameter arithmetic is replayed exactly in the bundled checker.

originality.rationale: Scalar stochastic-logistic thresholds and stochastic cooperative-population methods are established prior art and are not claimed as new. The accepted result is the source-specific synthesis for the exact jellyfish SDE: positive polyp self-renewal alone gives full persistence in mean of the source's weighted population, independently of medusa noise, strictly weakening the two-stage noise hypothesis of the motivating theorem. No checked source states this one-condition theorem or its quantitative source-parameter witness.

value.rationale: The motivating article interprets small environmental noise in both stages as a requirement for survival. The new theorem identifies a stronger and biologically interpretable robustness mechanism: if polyp self-renewal beats polyp noise, the full weighted population has a positive long-time mean even under arbitrarily large medusa noise. The source-parameter witness lies outside its theorem by a large margin yet receives an explicit quantitative persistence guarantee, making the extension materially useful rather than a routine reparameterization.
